mechanism: Per-launch device completion of the routing-mask elementwise compare (aten ne.Scalar, int32 source -> bool result) and conversion (aten _to_copy/copy_, bool -> BF16) services on dedicated independent probe tensors, measured as an NPU-graph-captured chain of 256 identical back-to-back ops with NPU event timing.  The measured law is affine: t = setup + N / rate, where the steady term is the chip-level serialized completion-stream rate of back-to-back dependent elementwise launches.  The steady rate does NOT parallelize across the 48 AIV workers (measured: per-launch completion grows with total N at constant per-worker elements), so the service is consumed as a single-owner worker stream.  The probe never replays the production router chain, never touches the serving dataset, and consumes no production or evaluation duration.
calibration_method: Per-cell median over the 60 graph-mode trials pooled from run1 and run2 across the 11 production-domain element counts; ordinary least squares on t(seconds) = setup + N/rate.
validation_method: Run3 is an independent holdout run: per-cell median of its 30 graph-mode trials, maximum absolute percentage error over all 11 cells against the calibrated law.
